paite: Khokheng tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung;
heading: Keuna Mulkimhuai
english: The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.

paite: Judah in asuun a, akulh kongpite angui; lei ah puan vom khu in akun ua, Jerusalem kah ging atungkah.
english: Judah mourns, and its gates languish, they sit in black on the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

paite: Amilalte'n asikhate uh tui atawisak ua, tuichin azuan ua, tui amu kei uh, tuibel hawm in akik ua; abeidong ua, gen ding athei kei ua, alu uh akhuh uhi.
english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters: they come to the cisterns, and find no water; they return with their vessels empty; they are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

paite: Gam pum a vuahtui a-om louh ziak in lei akhang a, lei let mite alungdong ua, alu uh akhuh uh.
english: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed, they cover their heads.

paite: Ahi, zukpi in leng loubuk ah nou anei a, louhing a-om louh ziak in ataisan hi.
english: Yes, the hind also in the field calves, and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

paite: Gam sabiltungte mualvum ah adingh ua, sehal bang in huihkhua ngai in anak huhu ua; nek ding loupa om louh ziak in amit uh amial dundun hi.
english: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights, they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail, because there is no herbage.

paite: Ka thulimlouhna un hon hek mahleh na min ziak in aw TOUPA hong kuan in; ka puknate uh lah atamta ngal a, na tung mahmah ah thil ka na hihkhial uhi.
english: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, Yahweh; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.

paite: Aw nang Israelte lamet, mangbat lai a hondampa, bangziak a hiai gam a mikhual bang zen a zan khat giak a zin bang lel a om na hia?
english: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

paite: Bangziak a mi lungkegawp bang phet leh pasalpha hondam thei lou bang lel a om na hia? Himahleh nang zaw, aw TOUPA, ka lak uah na om lai a, na min ka pu ua, hon paisan ke'n.
english: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, Yahweh, are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; don’t leave us.

paite: TOUPA'N hiai mite tungtang ah hichi in achi: Vakmang a-ut nak ua, akalsuan uh akidek kei uh; huchi in TOUPA'N amau apom kei a, athulimlouhna uh atheigigeta ding a, akhelhna uh agawt ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh to this people, Even so have they loved to wander; they have not refrained their feet: therefore Yahweh does not accept them; now he will remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai mite hoihna ding ngetsak ke'n.
english: Yahweh said to me, Don’t pray for this people for their good.

paite: An ngawl mah le uh akikou uh ka ngaikhe kei ding a, halmang leh buh-le-bal thillat lan mah le uh ka dawng kei ding; namsau, kial, hipi in amau ka hihmang zaw ding," achi hi.
english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

paite: Ke'n, "Eh, Toupa PATHIAN, ngai dih, akiang uah zawlneite'n, 'Namsau na tuak kei ding ua, kial leng na thuak kei ding uh, hiai mun ah muan mahmahna ka hon pe zaw ding hi, achi sek ngal ua,' " ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, Ah, Lord Yahweh! behold, the prophets tell them, You shall not see the sword, neither shall you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Zawlneite'n ka min a zuau gen zel ahi ve ua le; amau ka sawl kei a, thu ka khak kei a, ka houpih sam kei hi. Thil amuh kholhlouhte uh, aisan bangmah a pangloute leh alungsim dohate uh hon hilh ahi ve ua," achi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name; I didn’t send them, neither have I commanded them, neither spoke I to them: they prophesy to you a lying vision, and divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ka sawl louh a ka min lou a, 'Hiai gam ah kial leh namsau atung kei ding,' chi a zawlnei thugen genmi, huai zawlneite namsau leh kial in amangthang ding uh.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, and I didn’t send them, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land: By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

paite: Huan athugenna uh nam leng kial leh namsau ziak in Jerusalem kongzing ah paihkhiak ahi ding ua, atanute uh atapate uh toh, vuimi himhim anei kei ding uh. Athulimlouhna uh amau tung ah ka sung dek ngal a."
english: The people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them—them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness on them.

paite: Huan akiang ua hiai thu na gen ding ahi: "Sun leh zan in ka khitui luang hen, hul himhim kei hen, ka mi, ka tanu nungak siangthou in nakpi a liamna atuak hi, khutkhak na mahmah toh.
english: You shall say this word to them, Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

paite: Gam a ka pawtleh, maizen, namsau a thahte! Khopi a ka lutleh, maizen, kialpi a misi! Gam chih ah zawlneite, siampute avakvai chiat ua, adan mahmah athei kei uh," chi in.
english: If I go forth into the field, then, behold, the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then, behold, those who are sick with famine! for both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.

paite: Judah paikhe siang na hi hiam? Zion kih na hi maw? Kou a dia hihdamna om lou bikbek a bangziak a hon thuaksak na hia? Muanna ka zong ua, hoihna bangmah ahong tung kei; hihdamna hun ding leng, ngai dih buaina lel.
heading: Mipite'n TOUPA Angen Uh
english: Have you utterly rejected Judah? has your soul loathed Zion? why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka thulimlouhdan uh ka kitheihmohbawl kei uhi, ka pipute uh ginatlouhna toh, na tung ah ka hihkhialta uhi.
english: We acknowledge, Yahweh, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

paite: Na min ziak in hon musit ke'n, na laltutphah thupi minsesak ke'nla, ka kiang ua na thukhun theigige in hihse ke'n.
english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake; do not disgrace the throne of your glory: remember, don’t break your covenant with us.

paite: Namdangte pathiante lak ah vuah zusak thei a-om uhia? Ahihleh, van in vuahpi atungsak thei hia? Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, huai pen nang na hi kei maw? Hiai thil tengteng na hih ahi a, ka lamet uh nang na hi.
english: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh our God? therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.
